title: Externalizing Requirement-to-Repair Artifacts as Observable Traces for LLM-Based Program Repair
abstract: arXiv:2609.14913v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Repository-level repair requires not only correct patches but also inspectable records that explain how issue requirements are translated into code changes and post-edit evidence. We contribute THEMIS, a stage-aware repair workflow that externalizes this requirement-to-repair process through semantic interpretation, a runtime requirement-code graph, graph-derived Developer guidance, retained repair rationale and patches, and post-edit audit records. A retrospective audit of 300 SWE-bench Lite cases demonstrates that these artifacts provide broad support for cross-stage inspection: a complete Developer rationale is available for 288 cases, and 214 cases (71.3%) retain a complete audited field set connecting the selected stages. translated_title: 将需求到修复的产物外化为可观察的痕迹以支持基于大语言模型的程序修复
translated_abstract: 仓库级修复不仅需要正确的补丁，还需要可检查的记录，用以解释问题需求如何被转化为代码变更以及编辑后的证据。我们提出了THEMIS，一种阶段感知的修复工作流，它通过语义解释、运行时需求-代码图、由图导出的开发者指导、保留的修复理据与补丁，以及编辑后审计记录，将这一需求到修复的过程外化。对300个SWE-bench Lite案例的回顾性审计表明，这些产物为跨阶段检查提供了广泛支持：288个案例具备完整的开发者理据，214个案例（71.3%）保留了连接所选阶段的完整审计字段集。保留的记录进一步支持了对跨阶段对应关系的系统性度量：目标符号在62.6%的开发者理据和62.8%的补丁中重复出现，当计入相关符号时该比例上升至75.8%。
tldr: 提出THEMIS阶段感知修复工作流，将基于大语言模型的程序修复过程中从需求到修复的各阶段产物（语义解释、需求-代码图、修复理据、补丁及审计记录）外化为可观察痕迹，实现对修复过程的跨阶段检查与系统性审计验证。
en_tdlr: THEMIS is a stage-aware repair workflow that externalizes the requirement-to-repair process of LLM-based program repair as observable traces—including semantic interpretations, runtime requirement-code graphs, repair rationales, patches, and audit records—enabling cross-stage inspection and systematic measurement of repair consistency.
